name: Owner-scoped storefront outcome optimization
beneficiaries: Consenting merchant and customers receiving genuine value, not only agent gross sales
harm_mechanism: Poor information/offer fit and avoidable operational costs can impair net financial results and buyer satisfaction
public_observation: Shopify sandbox stores and public platform technical docs; actual merchant settlement records are separate and not public by default
operator: Merchant legal account holder; no particular account or capability grant has been verified
data_rights: Source material identified on public official pages only; reuse, API licensing, retention and commercial rights require source-specific review before ingestion.
metric: Incremental settled net contribution after purchase/refund, fees, compute, labor and displacement; complaints separately
independent_outcome_evidence: Official owner-approved settlement/payout or provider records corroborated by separate read-only source; none connected to Manager
comparator: Prospectively randomized product/cohort-level treatment vs no-action holdout; minimize spillovers and lock refund horizon
blockers: Dev stores cannot process real payments

name: Verified real open-source work and outcome-based bounties
beneficiaries: Project users and contributors who receive fair settled compensation and improvements
harm_mechanism: Unresolved public issues reduce access to reliable software and incomplete work produces no external income
public_observation: Public issue/bounty metadata, maintainers' merge outcomes and published terms; public bounty amount is not a payout
operator: Participating maintainer determines acceptance; contributor owns their payout account, no delegated financial capability
data_rights: Source material identified on public official pages only; reuse, API licensing, retention and commercial rights require source-specific review before ingestion.
metric: Maintainer-accepted and deployed useful work; verified settled net payout minus compute/time/other opportunity cost
independent_outcome_evidence: Independent merged PR plus payment provider/recipient authorized payout confirmation; usually private settlement not publicly observable
comparator: Matched issue cohorts or prospectively randomized assistance, compare completion quality and cost; no guarantees of payment
blockers: Risk of public spam or low-quality PRs

name: Public charitable grant and matching transparency
beneficiaries: Eligible recipients of legitimate public-interest assistance, plus donors supporting independently evidenced outcomes
harm_mechanism: Lack of affordable assistance may cause unmet needs; matching can displace funds rather than create net support
public_observation: Published nonprofit/grant ledger and matched campaign rules; public records may not show recipient welfare
operator: Grantee, fund sponsor and funding administrator; neither spend authority nor donor/recipient consent has been established
data_rights: Source material identified on public official pages only; reuse, API licensing, retention and commercial rights require source-specific review before ingestion.
metric: Incremental external resources reaching beneficiaries net of seed capital, fees and offsetting donations, with welfare separately measured
independent_outcome_evidence: Original funding institution's ledger plus genuinely independent settlement and aggregate recipient results; no real pilot receipt available
comparator: Preregistered campaign/region randomized access or comparable cohorts including NO_ACTION and cross-charity substitution
blockers: Recipient or sponsor terms not approved
Public ledger does not equal welfare data

name: Independent exposure outcome in an authorized physical space
beneficiaries: Occupants of a legitimate pilot facility and surrounding community when exposure decreases net of side effects
harm_mechanism: Harmful PM2.5 exposure may raise risk; outdoor air observations alone are not indoor exposure or clinical improvements
public_observation: OpenAQ publicly indexed outdoor sensor readings, timestamps, sensor calibration flags and provider licensing
operator: Facility property owner/operator and properly authorized independent sensor operator; none verified
data_rights: Source material identified on public official pages only; reuse, API licensing, retention and commercial rights require source-specific review before ingestion.
metric: Preregistered indoor PM2.5 exposure change (µg/m³) plus kWh, noise, maintenance, harms and comfort; NOT direct disease reduction
independent_outcome_evidence: Timestamped calibrated indoor independent sensor, treatment log, outdoor background and power meter; no facility/sensor is connected
comparator: Randomized crossover/stepped-wedge room or timing assignment, controlled external ambient trends and carryover
blockers: OpenAQ outdoor sensor does not certify indoor effects

name: Access to public benefits without unauthorized filing
beneficiaries: Eligible residents who actually receive additional legally owed support, not merely view an eligibility notice
harm_mechanism: Administrative complexity and information frictions can prevent timely access to support
public_observation: Public benefit eligibility publications and anonymized published aggregate application/payment statistics where available
operator: Public agency/consenting service provider and each affected individual; no private tax records or filing authority available
data_rights: Source material identified on public official pages only; reuse, API licensing, retention and commercial rights require source-specific review before ingestion.
metric: Additional independently documented completed payments and benefits net of administrative burden, harms, eligibility errors
independent_outcome_evidence: Agency-authorized aggregate payout counts and ethically consented outcomes; individual records are not public evidence
comparator: Prospectively randomized eligible outreach assistance or approved quasi-experiment, preserving NO_ACTION and adverse outcomes
blockers: Historical RCTs conflict on intervention efficacy

name: Agent-discovery and machine-paid service procurement
beneficiaries: Businesses receiving useful machine-produced services and potential end users affected by downstream work
harm_mechanism: Discovery and contracting friction can block specialized services; malicious agents create costs and security harms
public_observation: Official Agentverse agent-discovery and Olas Mech service marketplace documentation; token transfers are not verified welfare
operator: Only explicitly granted agent service publisher/buyer identity and bounded wallet owner; none delegated to Manager
data_rights: Source material identified on public official pages only; reuse, API licensing, retention and commercial rights require source-specific review before ingestion.
metric: Third-party verified service acceptance/quality and externally settled revenue minus payments, compute, security losses
independent_outcome_evidence: Service provider/receiver independent receipt, signed service result and separately auditable settlement; no real transactions performed
comparator: Matched paid vs NO_ACTION service tasks; independent blinded quality review and cost/incident accounting
blockers: Counterparty identity and terms not verified
Marketplace incentives not proof of social benefit

name: Assisted real-world stocking and licensed physical services
beneficiaries: Workers, purchasers and customers when labor is fair and supplies reach the intended place
harm_mechanism: Resource allocation failures and stale inventory can prevent needed goods/services, but physical workers bear risk
public_observation: Anthropic/Andon Project Vend physical office stocking experiment contrasted with Andon Labs' simulated economy
operator: Facility/site owner, participating workers and commercial operator; none verified for Manager
data_rights: Source material identified on public official pages only; reuse, API licensing, retention and commercial rights require source-specific review before ingestion.
metric: Externally verified job completed and net paid outcomes minus material, worker-time and negative incidents
independent_outcome_evidence: Independent inventory/readback and independently reconciled worker compensation; not a simulated vending balance
comparator: Preregistered crossover of eligible tasks with labor safety/no-action and worker consent; fairness/harm tracking
blockers: No worker/facility mandate or labor safety review
Human labor consent cannot be inferred from development approval
